title: The Cloud Factory
moral: Rainy days and sunny days are all precious. Come play again, little cloud!
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본. text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, new 만 새로 녹음한다(trim 없음). 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.set:<01_road|02_hill|03_chimney|04_door|: 장면 배경(scene 키). scenes[].set 으로 자동 호출, 한 장면 안에서 바꿀 때는 before 에 둔다
acts.sky:drift | chimney:steam | chimney:clou: 하늘 구름 떠다님·굴뚝 김·김이 뭉쳐 구름·구름이 토끼·물고기·자동차로
acts.door:open | belt:drops | horn:blow | clo: 공장 연출(놀이판의 누르기 뒤 연출을 저절로)

lines.text: 해가 쨍쨍한 날, 다현이와 이현이와 은우는 꿀떡이랑 산책을 나가요.
lines.en: On a sunny day, Dahyun, Ihyun, and Eunwoo go for a walk with Kkulddeok.
segs: On a sunny day, Dahyun, Ihyun, and Eunwoo go for a walk with Kkulddeok.

lines.en: Clouds float across the sky.

lines.text: 햇살은 따끈따끈, 바람은 살랑살랑 기분 좋은 날이에요.
lines.en: The sunshine is toasty warm, the breeze is soft and gentle. What a lovely day.
segs: The sunshine is toasty warm, the breeze is soft and gentle. What a lovely day.

lines.en: Where do clouds come from?
Kkulddeok puts his nose to the ground. Sniff, sniff.
segs: Kkulddeok puts his nose to the ground. Sniff, sniff.

lines.en: Sniff sniff sniff! Kkulddeok smells something.
segs: Sniff sniff sniff! Kkulddeok smells something.

lines.en: Kkulddeok's tail goes swish, swish, and his ears perk right up!
segs: Kkulddeok's tail goes swish, swish, and his ears perk right up!

lines.en: He runs off, following the smell.
segs: He runs off, following the smell.

lines.en: Kkulddeok, wait for us!
Heave-ho, heave-ho! The three kids climb the hill.
segs: Heave-ho, heave-ho! The three kids climb the hill.

lines.text: 다현이는 성큼성큼, 이현이는 씩씩하게, 은우는 아장아장 따라가요.
lines.en: Dahyun takes big strides, Ihyun marches bravely, and Eunwoo toddles along behind.
segs: Dahyun takes big strides, Ihyun marches bravely, and Eunwoo toddles along behind.

lines.en: Over the hill, there is a big chimney.
segs: Over the hill, there is a big chimney.

lines.en: White steam puffs out of the chimney.
segs: White steam puffs out of the chimney.

lines.text: 삼남매는 눈을 동그랗게 뜨고 굴뚝을 올려다봐요.
lines.en: The three kids look up at the chimney with big, round eyes.
segs: The three kids look up at the chimney with big, round eyes.

lines.text: 김이 뭉치고, 뭉치고… 퐁! 구름이 됐어요.
lines.en: The steam rolls together, and together... Pong! It turns into a cloud.
segs: The steam rolls together, and together... Pong! It turns into a cloud.

lines.en: So this is where clouds come from!
segs: So this is where clouds come from!

lines.en: Pong! Eunwoo says it too.

lines.text: 구름이 쏙! 토끼, 물고기, 자동차로 바뀌어요.
lines.en: The clouds change! A rabbit, a fish, and a car.
segs: The clouds change! A rabbit, a fish, and a car.

lines.en: Kkulddeok looks at the clouds and barks, woof, woof!
segs: Kkulddeok looks at the clouds and barks, woof, woof!

lines.en: Under the chimney, there is a big door.
segs: Under the chimney, there is a big door.

lines.en: What kind of factory... could this be?
segs: What kind of factory... could this be?

lines.text: 꿀떡이가 문틈에 코를 쏙 밀어 넣어요.
lines.en: Kkulddeok pokes his nose into the gap in the door.
segs: Kkulddeok pokes his nose into the gap in the door.

lines.text: 꿀떡이 코가 문틈에서 킁킁, 꼬리가 흔들흔들.
lines.en: Kkulddeok's nose goes sniff, sniff at the gap, and his tail wags back and forth.
segs: Kkulddeok's nose goes sniff, sniff at the gap, and his tail wags back and forth.

lines.en: Creeeak... the door swings open.
The three kids tiptoe in after him.
segs: The three kids tiptoe in after him.

lines.en: From inside comes a strange, wonderful sound. Clunk-a-clunk, clunk-a-clunk.
segs: From inside comes a strange, wonderful sound. Clunk-a-clunk, clunk-a-clunk.

lines.text: 기다란 벨트 위로 물방울이 똑, 똑, 똑.
lines.en: Water drops fall onto a long belt. Drip, drip, drip.
segs: Water drops fall onto a long belt. Drip, drip, drip.

lines.text: 물방울들이 벨트를 따라 또르르, 또르르 굴러가요.
lines.en: The water drops roll along the belt, roly-poly, roly-poly.
segs: The water drops roll along the belt, roly-poly, roly-poly.

lines.text: 이현이가 물방울에 손을 살짝 대 봐요.
lines.en: Ihyun gently touches a water drop.
segs: Ihyun gently touches a water drop.

lines.en: Ooh, cold! It is a real water drop!
segs: Ooh, cold! It is a real water drop!

lines.en: Dahyun blows a big breath. Whoooo!
segs: Dahyun blows a big breath. Whoooo!

lines.en: Puff, puff puff, puff puff puff! Pong!
segs: Puff, puff puff, puff puff puff! Pong!

lines.text: 하얀 구름이 둥실, 벨트 위로 떠올라요.
lines.en: A white cloud floats up, bobbing gently over the belt.
segs: A white cloud floats up, bobbing gently over the belt.

lines.en: This is a cloud factory!

lines.text: 이현이가 모양 틀을 힘껏, 쿵! 내리찍어요.
lines.en: Ihyun pushes the shape press down with all his might. Clunk!
segs: Ihyun pushes the shape press down with all his might. Clunk!

lines.text: 퐁! 토끼 구름. 퐁! 고래 구름.
lines.en: Pong! A bunny cloud. Pong! A whale cloud.
segs: Pong! A bunny cloud. Pong! A whale cloud.

lines.en: Pong! And now, a puppy cloud.
segs: Pong! And now, a puppy cloud.

lines.text: 토끼 구름은 깡충, 고래 구름은 출렁, 강아지 구름은 멍멍!
lines.en: The bunny cloud goes hop, the whale cloud goes splash, and the puppy cloud goes woof!
segs: The bunny cloud goes hop, the whale cloud goes splash, and the puppy cloud goes woof!

lines.en: The clouds bob and float, drifting all around the factory.
segs: The clouds bob and float, drifting all around the factory.

lines.en: Kkulddeok touches noses with the puppy cloud.
segs: Kkulddeok touches noses with the puppy cloud.

lines.en: Achoo! Little bits of cloud float away.
segs: Achoo! Little bits of cloud float away.

lines.en: In the corner, there is a big red button.
segs: In the corner, there is a big red button.

lines.en: What is that red button for? I want to know!
segs: What is that red button for? I want to know!

lines.text: 은우가 아장아장 다가가 단추를 꾸욱 눌렀어요.
lines.en: Eunwoo toddles over and pushes the button down, pu-u-ush!
segs: Eunwoo toddles over and pushes the button down, pu-u-ush!

lines.en: Whoosh! The puppy cloud zooms up the chimney.
segs: Whoosh! The puppy cloud zooms up the chimney.

lines.en: Pong! Out into the sky it goes.
segs: Pong! Out into the sky it goes.

lines.en: The three kids clapped and clapped. Clap, clap, clap!
segs: The three kids clapped and clapped. Clap, clap, clap!

lines.en: The next room is dark. It is the rain cloud room.
segs: The next room is dark. It is the rain cloud room.

lines.en: The rain clouds drink water from a big tank.
segs: The rain clouds drink water from a big tank.

lines.en: Gulp, gulp, gulp. Their tummies get big and round.
segs: Gulp, gulp, gulp. Their tummies get big and round.

lines.text: 물통 속 물은 출렁출렁, 먹구름 배는 볼록볼록.
lines.en: The water in the tank goes slosh, slosh, and the rain clouds' tummies go bulge, bulge.
segs: The water in the tank goes slosh, slosh, and the rain clouds' tummies go bulge, bulge.

lines.en: I think they're making rain.
Kkulddeok sniffs the wet floor.
Ding, ding, ding! The bell rings.
segs: Ding, ding, ding! The bell rings.

lines.en: The rain clouds line up and go outside.
segs: The rain clouds line up and go outside.

lines.en: The puffy rain clouds go up the chimney, one after another, in a long, long line.
segs: The puffy rain clouds go up the chimney, one after another, in a long, long line.

lines.text: 구석에 아기 먹구름 하나가 혼자 웅크리고 있어요.
lines.en: In the corner, one baby rain cloud is curled up all alone.
segs: In the corner, one baby rain cloud is curled up all alone.

lines.en: I don't want to go. Everybody hates rain.
segs: I don't want to go. Everybody hates rain.

lines.text: 혼자 웅크리고 있어요. 슬픈 것 같아요.
lines.en: It is curled up all alone. It looks sad.
segs: It is curled up all alone. It looks sad.

lines.en: A tear rolls down the baby rain cloud's cheek, drip, drop.
segs: A tear rolls down the baby rain cloud's cheek, drip, drop.

lines.en: Kkulddeok tiptoes closer.
Eunwoo gently pats the baby rain cloud.
segs: Eunwoo gently pats the baby rain cloud.

lines.text: 토닥토닥, 쓰담쓰담. 아기 먹구름이 조금씩 고개를 들어요.
lines.en: Pat, pat. Stroke, stroke. Little by little, the baby rain cloud lifts its head.
segs: Pat, pat. Stroke, stroke. Little by little, the baby rain cloud lifts its head.

lines.en: We love rain! We put on our boots and splash!
segs: We love rain! We put on our boots and splash!

lines.en: Splash, splash! Ihyun jumps too.
Kkulddeok licks the baby cloud's cheek. Lick!
segs: Kkulddeok licks the baby cloud's cheek. Lick!

lines.en: The baby rain cloud's eyes go big and round.
segs: The baby rain cloud's eyes go big and round.

lines.en: Really? Then I'll go!

lines.text: 슈웅— 아기 먹구름이 굴뚝으로 올라가요. 퐁!
lines.en: Whoosh! The baby rain cloud zooms up the chimney. Pong!
segs: Whoosh! The baby rain cloud zooms up the chimney. Pong!

lines.text: 삼남매도 손을 흔들며 밖으로 달려 나가요.
lines.en: The three kids wave and run outside.
segs: The three kids wave and run outside.

lines.en: Kkulddeok looks up at the sky. Woof! Woof!
segs: Kkulddeok looks up at the sky. Woof! Woof!

lines.text: 하늘에서 아기 먹구름이 큰 먹구름과 쿵!
lines.en: Up in the sky, the baby rain cloud bumps into a big rain cloud. Bump!
segs: Up in the sky, the baby rain cloud bumps into a big rain cloud. Bump!

lines.en: Flash! Rumble, BOOM!
The sky goes rumble, rumble, and the kids' hearts go thump, thump.
segs: The sky goes rumble, rumble, and the kids' hearts go thump, thump.

lines.en: Eek! The three kids hug each other tight.
segs: The three kids hug each other tight.

lines.en: Sorry, sorry! We were just saying hello!
segs: Sorry, sorry! We were just saying hello!

lines.text: 삼남매는 휴우, 가슴을 쓸어내리고 까르르 웃었어요.
lines.en: The three kids let out a big sigh, phew, and then burst out giggling.
segs: The three kids let out a big sigh, phew, and then burst out giggling.

lines.en: Kkulddeok wags his tail, wiggle wiggle.
segs: Kkulddeok wags his tail, wiggle wiggle.

lines.text: 토독, 토도독. 빗방울이 하나, 둘 떨어져요.
lines.en: Plip, plop, plip-plop. The raindrops fall, one, then two.
segs: Plip, plop, plip-plop. The raindrops fall, one, then two.

lines.en: It's raining!
The three kids and Kkulddeok splash in the puddles!
segs: The three kids and Kkulddeok splash in the puddles!

lines.en: Splash! Eunwoo jumps the highest.

lines.text: 장화 속까지 철벅철벅, 그래도 신이 나요.
lines.en: Their boots go squelch, squelch, soaking wet, but they are having so much fun.
segs: Their boots go squelch, squelch, soaking wet, but they are having so much fun.

lines.en: From the rainy ground, a little sprout pops up!
segs: From the rainy ground, a little sprout pops up!

lines.en: A flower opens wide!
A strawberry turns red!

lines.text: 새싹은 쑥쑥, 꽃은 방긋, 딸기는 반질반질 윤이 나요.
lines.en: The sprouts shoot up, the flowers smile, and the strawberries shine, glossy and bright.
segs: The sprouts shoot up, the flowers smile, and the strawberries shine, glossy and bright.

lines.en: Kkulddeok sniffs the strawberry.

lines.text: 아기 먹구름이 내려다봐요. "어? 다들 웃고 있네!"
lines.en: The baby rain cloud looks down. Oh? Everyone is smiling!
segs: The baby rain cloud looks down.

lines.en: A big rainbow in the sky! Wow!
segs: A big rainbow in the sky!

lines.text: 빨강, 주황, 노랑, 초록, 파랑, 남색, 보라. 일곱 색이 반짝반짝 빛나요.
lines.en: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet. Seven colors sparkle and shine.
segs: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet. Seven colors sparkle and shine.

lines.text: 비를 다 내린 아기 먹구름은 하얗게 변했어요.
lines.en: After raining all its rain, the baby rain cloud turns white.
segs: After raining all its rain, the baby rain cloud turns white.

lines.text: 하얀 아기 구름이 방긋 웃어요. 퐁!
lines.en: The little white cloud smiles. Pong!
segs: The little white cloud smiles. Pong!

lines.en: So this is where clouds come from!
segs: So this is where clouds come from!

lines.text: 꿀떡이는 젖은 흙에 코를 대고 킁킁.
lines.en: Kkulddeok puts his nose to the wet dirt. Sniff, sniff.
segs: Kkulddeok puts his nose to the wet dirt. Sniff, sniff.

lines.text: 삼남매는 꿀떡이랑 왔던 길로 집에 가요.
lines.en: The three kids and Kkulddeok walk home the way they came.
segs: The three kids and Kkulddeok walk home the way they came.

lines.text: 멀리 굴뚝에서 작은 구름이 퐁! 퐁!
lines.en: Far away, little clouds pop out of the chimney. Pong! Pong!
segs: Far away, little clouds pop out of the chimney. Pong! Pong!

lines.en: Eunwoo looks back and waves. Pong!
Come play again, little cloud!

lines.text: 꿀떡이는 굴뚝 쪽 바람을 마지막으로 킁킁.
lines.en: Kkulddeok takes one last sniff of the wind from the chimney.
segs: Kkulddeok takes one last sniff of the wind from the chimney.

lines.text: 비 오는 날도, 해 뜨는 날도 모두 소중하답니다.
lines.en: Rainy days and sunny days, every one of them is precious.
segs: Rainy days and sunny days, every one of them is precious.
